Use-case summary:
- Goal: automated ticket summarization + structured output to populate Zendesk fields (priority, category, SLA code) and enable tool-calling to run triage actions (assign, escalate, create follow-ups).
- Pipeline: existing Zendesk -> webhook -> internal worker. Want Redwood hosted_api to replace OpenAI trial for cheaper, predictable costs and function/tool calling.

Performance & cost constraints:
- Peak expected workload ~15-30 req/s for summaries; initial A/B on 500 tickets. Target p95 latency <400ms for single-turn summary calls; batch enrichment ok to be slower.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; target <$0.02 per summarized ticket if possible. Need 1k/10k/month billing projections.

Model & integration preferences:
- Prefer curated open models or Redwood-verified variants; deterministic structured output required (JSON schema + function calling).
- Need SDK snippets (node/python) and example function-calling snippets to wire into Zendesk.

Security & compliance:
- Require SSO/SAML, audit logs for all API activity, KMS integration for key management. Legal asks: data retention 90 days, ability to delete logs on request. Provided SOC2 requirement for procurement.
